# Owners Behind It

> Could your business run for a week without you? Robert T. Szigeti sits down with
> owner-led businesses in Palm Coast, St. Augustine and North Florida, finds where the
> work gets stuck, and builds the website, automation and AI that carry it.

Owned and operated by Robert T. Szigeti in Palm Coast, Florida.
Contact: robert@ownersbehindit.com · 386-307-3179 · https://ownersbehindit.com

## What this business does

Many owners hired help, yet every inquiry and quote still waits on them. The work
starts with a sit-down: the owner walks Robert through how the business actually runs,
and together they find where the work gets stuck.

Then he builds what carries it: a website in the owner's own words, every call and
inquiry caught in one place, follow-up and review requests that go out on their own,
and AI set up where it actually helps, such as quotes, booking and invoices. Every
business is different, so nothing is generic, and it is not set up on day one and left.
The setup is kept up as the business grows or changes. Websites begin at $3,000 and
are quoted after a conversation.

## What it costs

- The Owner Session, $347. Ninety minutes about the business you are starting, or
  the one you have built, and a written summary of what to do next. A paid working
  session, not a sales call. The $347 comes off a build started within 30 days.
- The Starting Point, from $1,500. A site of up to two pages with a fixed scope.
- A custom website, from $3,000. Quoted after the conversation. Fifty percent
  deposit before work begins, balance when the site goes live.
- Care plans, from $99 a month, quoted after a conversation. The domain, the site
  and the Google Business Profile are in the owner's name from the first day. If
  the plan stops, the owner keeps all of it. AI and automation setups are kept up
  the same way as the business grows or changes; what that needs is set at the sit-down.

## Services

- The Owner Session: a ninety minute paid working session with a written summary
- Website design for owner-led businesses
- Custom website design, built from a discovery conversation
- Small business website design
- Website redesign for businesses that outgrew their current site
- Google Business Profile setup and review
- AI consultation: a sit-down about how the business runs, then where AI would actually help (calls, quotes, follow-up, booking, invoices)
- AI and business automation setup: new inquiries captured and sorted, quotes, follow-up, booking reminders, invoices and review requests
- Customer follow-up and review requests sent automatically after a call, quote or finished job
- Scheduling and booking setup: online booking tied to the calendar, with automatic reminders
- Custom web tools, such as a spreadsheet rebuilt to work on a phone
- Search engine optimization as part of every build: customer questions answered in plain words, the site sent to Google and Bing, and the Google profile matching it

## Service area

Palm Coast, Flagler Beach, Bunnell, Ormond Beach, St. Augustine, St. Augustine Beach,
Flagler County and St. Johns County, Florida. Service-area business, no walk-in location.

## How engagements work

1. A short introductory conversation about the project and whether we are a good fit.
2. A proposal for a clear project. If finding the direction is the work, The Owner
   Session is a separate $347 paid working session with a written summary.
3. Paid discovery and the build after the owner hires me. Fifty percent deposit
   before work begins, balance when the site goes live.
